صُلَّبِىٌّ : see صُلَّبٌ. ―
-b2- Also A spear-head sharpened; (S, TA;) and so ↓ مُصَلَّبٌ , (S,) or ↓ صُلَّبٌ : (TA: [but this last is perhaps a mistranscription for مُصَلَّبٌ:]) or a thing polished and sharpened with whetstones: (K:) and ↓ مُصَلَّبٌ signifies a spear sharpened with the ضُلَّبِىّ, (M, TA,) or a spear-head sharpened upon the صُلَّب, which is like the whetstone. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
